title: CBARA: Covariate-Balanced-and-Adjusted Response-Adaptive Randomization
summary: We propose the covariate-balanced-and-adjusted response-adaptive randomization (CBARA) procedure for adaptive design in clinical trials, which integrates the complementary strengths of covariate-adjusted response-adaptive randomization (CARA) and covariate-adaptive randomization (CAR). The CBARA procedure updates the target allocation ratio according to observed responses and patient covariate profiles without requiring a correctly specified model, thereby retaining CARA's ethical and efficiency considerations while improving robustness.
